body: Fix: finetype infer zero-fills the feature vector for a feature-trained char-cnn, collapsing every prediction to representation.text.plain_text. cmd_infer (main.rs:1583 CharCnn branch) calls classify_batch -> model.infer -> infer_with_features(.., None); for feature_dim>0 (trained with --use-features) char_cnn.rs:599 zero-fills features, so the head runs on unseen inputs. classify_batch_with_features exists in finetype-model/src/inference.rs but no CLI command calls it. Repro: FINETYPE_MODEL=models/char-cnn-v15-gittables finetype infer -f <values> --model-type char-cnn -> all plain_text. Fix: cmd_infer should extract the 37-dim deterministic features and call classify_batch_with_features when has_features(), or hard-error on the mismatch. Affects any feature-trained char-cnn via infer, incl. models/char-cnn-v15-gittables.

Diagnose the locale-format proxy NO-GO (2 trips): dump per-column proxy predictions on the fixed 1000-file list, identify the ~335 container.object.json_array + ~98 identity.commerce.isbn corpus columns the proxy now mis-fires. Decide a targeted fix (json_array/isbn hard-negative in the blend, or format disambiguation) that clears them WITHOUT re-collapsing the numeric prior (which HELD this run: decimal 31.46%, integer 12.63%). Re-proxy before any overnight spend. Route NOT dead — ac-05 0-for-3 numeric-collapse curse broke when manufactured mass spread across 34 locale-format types. Evidence: output/mining-factory/locale-format/ac05_proxy_precheck.md

PROGRESS (2026-06-13 remote session): Diagnosis DONE — json_array trip is 92% prose-relabel noise (307/335 long-text cols v19 also mislabels), isbn small genuine over-emit (98 cols). Author approved documented exception (memory mfg-localefmt-proxy-exception) to take candidate to the real blocking gate. Overnight train RUNNING (scripts/overnight_mfg_localefmt.sh, 3 ReLU seeds, v19 recipe, FTMB mfg-blend-localefmt.ftmb). On completion fire scripts/eval_localefmt_candidate.sh for ac-06 (gold anchor + Sense drift + corpus-honest gate). Verdict = corpus-honest gate.

Bank the lat/lon efficacy win via a COORDINATE-ONLY targeted fix, not the 34-type blend. ac-06 proved the manufactured coordinate corpus makes the lat/lon confusion family PERFECT on gold (latitude P0.975/R1.0, longitude P1.0/R0.978), but the full 34-type additive blend is a corpus-honest NO-GO (identifier-boundary collapse: numeric_code->7%, npi->18%; user_agent/isbn explosions). Try blending ONLY the coordinate types (or a minimal subset) and re-gate — the collateral may be carried by the geography/identifier-adjacent manufactured types, not the coordinates. See memory mfg-localefmt-identifier-collapse.

Fix the currency subtype-vs-generic-amount granularity clash. ac-06 gold shows finance.currency.amount at P0.100 because the model predicts manufactured SUBTYPES (amount_comma, amount_lakh, ...) where the gold fixture uses the generic finance.currency.amount label. Either (a) remap the manufactured amount_* subtypes to the generic amount label at train time, or (b) add the subtypes to the gold/taxonomy as first-class labels. Currently the locale-format currency content is a net NEGATIVE on gold. See output/mining-factory/locale-format/ac06_verdict.md.

Build the coordinate Sharpen VALUE-RULE (the evidence-backed delivery for coordinates). ac-06 proved: manufacturing makes lat/lon PERFECT on gold but EVERY additive-blend delivery (now 5 NO-GOs incl. pure-coord-only) causes corpus-scale collateral — coord-only relocated it onto the numeric family (numeric_code 59k->10.6k collapse, amount/si_number over-emit). Mechanism is representational (coord decimals vs numeric decimals), unfixable by dose or logit-adjust. Build a value-based rule: latitude in [-90,90], longitude in [-180,180], decimal sub-degree precision, value-only (choice 0048/0096). gold+corpus-honest gate it. Zero model risk, banks the proven efficacy win. See output/mining-factory/coord-only/ac06_verdict.md + memory coord-only-blend-numeric-collateral.

DEFERRED from 0.6.30 close-out (2026-06-14): (1) apply_header_sharpen needs a clean post-sharpen guard hook — value-identical-boundary guards that fire on hint-CREATED labels (e.g. amount_bare_number_veto) are unreachable inside apply_header_sharpen because hint paths early-return; the veto had to move to the caller. Add an explicit 'final guards run unconditionally' stage so the next such rule isn't a trap. (2) Pre-existing latent clippy error surfaced by agent B: clippy::type_complexity in crates/finetype-train/src/bin/train_fusion_head.rs:177 — fails -D warnings on rust-1.94.0 (newer than current CI toolchain); will break CI clippy when CI updates. One-line #[allow] or type alias. (3) Pre-existing test sense_train::tests::test_train_sense_fixture_loss_decreases fails locally on unmodified tree (loss-decrease assertion) but CI is green — investigate flake vs CI-skip. (4) Training checkpoint-resume: train-multi-branch cannot resume a killed run (wastes the whole run); larger design task. column.rs split remains on card 0019 scenario 5.
